287          decode_ordinal = 0
 288          num_chunks = 2 * self.pcp_world_size
 289          replicated = self.replicated_requests(num_scheduled_tokens, is_prefilling)
 290          for global_batch_req_idx, num_tokens in enumerate(num_scheduled_tokens):
 291              query_len = int(num_tokens)
 292              if query_len == 0:
 293                  continue
 294              chunk_indices: tuple[int, ...]

 296                  chunk_size = (query_len + num_chunks - 1) // num_chunks
 297                  chunk_indices = (rank, num_chunks - 1 - rank)
 298              elif self.shard_decode_requests:
 299                  chunk_size = query_len
 300                  # KV and hidden states are gathered back to every PCP rank, so
 301                  # decode ownership does not need to persist across steps. Use a
 302                  # compact decode-only ordinal to keep each step exactly
 303                  # balanced even when prefills and zero-token rows are present.
 304                  owner_rank = decode_ordinal % self.pcp_world_size
 305                  decode_ordinal += 1
 306                  chunk_indices = (0,) if rank == owner_rank else ()
 307              else:  # DCP requires decode queries on every participating rank.
 308                  chunk_size = query_len
 309                  chunk_indices = (0,)
 310  
 311              for chunk_idx in chunk_indices:
 312                  chunk_offset = chunk_idx * chunk_size
 313                  chunk_len = min(chunk_size, query_len - chunk_offset)
 314                  if chunk_len <= 0:
 315                      continue
 316                  yield global_batch_req_idx, chunk_offset, chunk_len

cp-lse.title: 按 LSE 恢复分片权重并合并
cp-lse.code:
568      # Compute max LSE for numerical stability
 569      lse_max, _ = lses.max(dim=0)  # [B, H]
 570      lse_max = torch.where(
 571          lse_max == float("-inf"),
 572          torch.zeros_like(lse_max),
 573          lse_max,
 574      )
 575  
 576      # Compute weights: softmax over the N dimension
 577      if is_lse_base_on_e:
 578          weights = torch.exp(lses - lse_max.unsqueeze(0))  # [N, B, H]
 579      else:
 580          weights = torch.pow(2.0, lses - lse_max.unsqueeze(0))  # [N, B, H]
 581  
 582      # Handle NaN weights
 583      weights = torch.where(torch.isnan(weights), torch.zeros_like(weights), weights)
 584  
 585      # Normalize weights
 586      weight_sum = weights.sum(dim=0, keepdim=True)  # [1, B, H]
 587      weights = weights / weight_sum.clamp(min=1e-10)  # [N, B, H]
 588  
 589      # Weighted combination: sum over N dimension
 590      weights = weights.unsqueeze(-1)
 591      outputs = torch.where(weights == 0, torch.zeros_like(outputs), outputs)
 592      result = (outputs * weights).sum(dim=0)  # [B, H, D]
